name: Topside systems
description: The distributed systems carried by the topside structure: process equipment and pipe racks; power generation/distribution and control; fire & gas and emergency shutdown; heating/ventilation/air conditioning; material-handling cranes; escape/lifesaving; helicopter decks; and inter-platform bridges.
